terms.comment: Our phrase: no reference work has a word for a screenshot. Imāgō as in Traupman’s imāgō phōtographica (see photo), quadrum as in screen. To take one, imāginem quadrī servāre, with Traupman’s servāre for saving (p. 262).

sources: Lewis & Short: imago · Lewis & Short: quadrum
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 262.
No source has a word for a screenshot.
